faq.title: Questions,
faq.description: The fast read on how Fintela works, what it costs, and where it fits.

assetClasses.q: What asset classes does Fintela support?
assetClasses.a: Currencies, U.S. equities, S&P indices, ETFs, forex, and global markets — all through the same unified strategy engine. Build a strategy once, test it across any cluster you define.

vsBacktesting.q: How is Fintela different from a standard backtesting library?
vsBacktesting.a: Fintela goes beyond backtesting — it unifies asset groups, strategy code, Bayesian parameter optimization, train/validation/OOS evaluation, portfolio analytics, and live deployment via your connected brokerage into a single pipeline. No exports, no scripts, no glue code between tools.

python.q: Do I need to know Python?
python.a: Yes, strategies are Python functions — but Fintelligent can generate them for you. Describe what you want in plain English and the agent writes the code, configures the parameters, and stages the form for your review.

optimization.a: Fintela uses Bayesian optimization, which learns from each trial to focus search on the most promising parameter regions. Every study is evaluated across three time windows — train (in-sample), validation (held-out), and out-of-sample — so robustness is built into the workflow.

seedExport.q: Can I export my strategy's signal?
seedExport.a: Yes. Every trial, basket, and sandbox run exposes its seed — the daily rebalancing signal (date → ticker → position/allocation) the engine used to build the backtest. You can inspect it date by date and download it as JSON (the exact engine input) or CSV, straight from the app.

liveTrading.a: Validated portfolios can be promoted to live operations that execute through your connected brokerage. You see real-time order logs, P&L, and a one-click pause. Multiple operations can run in parallel against different baskets.

security.a: Yes. Strategies and configurations are cryptographically hashed and time-stamped, ensuring authorship verification and tamper-proof auditability. The platform is fully cloud-hosted with enterprise-grade reliability.

poweredBy.q: Who is Fintelligent powered by, and is it safe?
poweredBy.a: Fintelligent runs on DeepSeek V4 (auto-routing between Pro and Flash) with Fintela-managed access — no API key to bring. Every tool call is visible in the chat, and every irreversible action (creating/stopping a study, deploying an operation) requires your explicit confirmation before execution.

speed.q: How fast can I go from idea to live capital?
speed.a: Most teams reach a fully validated, deployable strategy in 3 days — about 10× faster than traditional infrastructure. The bottleneck is the quality of the idea, not the tooling.
